methodology.scope: Read-only filesystem audit; no rollout, package import, database query, HDF5 payload, checkpoint weight load, or presentation edit.
methodology.primary_evidence: All nonblank JSONL rows counted by script; dedupe exact duplicate identity+record within run; preserve conflicting identity records rather than choose. All candidate reports cross-checked with TTL and HTML.
methodology.denominator: Completed/recorded episode rows, not requested episodes, number of environments, or seeds. No pooling different runs/versions. N=0 yields null rates, not 0% performance.
methodology.lift: Presence of completed object_is_above_height(...) progress event. This is a historical height predicate, not certified sustained lift or grasp. Active-but-uncompleted predicates do not count.
methodology.moved: TTL aggregate object_moved_rate; implied count = round(rate * telemetry N). Per-episode moved flags absent. Velocity criterion distinct from height predicate; current implementation reference metrics/object_moved.py:42-75.
methodology.conversion: Count(success=true AND completed lift event) / count(completed lift event), not independent success_count/lift_count.
methodology.duration: Conventional median averages central two values for even N. Upper-middle observation also retained to explain historical medians. Event step, episode length, wall timestamp span, and conditionally derived seconds are separate.
methodology.versions: Run TTL has family graph name only; explicit eval_dir lineage used where present, generation timing/next-version diagnostics otherwise. Current YAML/config hashes do not pin historical execution.
methodology.unknowns: No run-local manifests/config snapshots/checkpoint hashes/runtime source hashes found in candidate dirs. Seed 42 is observed for every nonempty run; remote diffusion seed and independent reset/layout sampling unknown.
methodology.presentation: Used to discover candidate names and audit claims only; never treated as measurement evidence.
methodology.static_source_caveat: Current code referenced for semantics is not historical run source certification.

corrections.finding: Named tomato 0/2,23/50,25/52,6/42 and spam18/70,13/67 match JSONL/TTL/HTML, but omit other runs; labels are not independently certified physical success.
Both grey-bin zero-action reports contain zero completed rows and TTL moved NaN, not lift100% over one episode. Number of envs or 300 requested steps is not a completed episode count.
Tomato N50 conversion is22/47, not23/47; N52 is23/44, not25/44. Success-without-lift episode identifiers retained.

Historical success labels and progress all_complete disagree in both directions; 23 N52 successes with lift are not equivalent to 23 strict-proximity completions. Only11/52 progress all_complete, of which10 also success.
Spam175/284 are lift-event timings (175 is upper-middle vs conventional173); not placement duration. Historical place timings often use upper-middle observation. Episode medians differ substantially.

Current tomato v1/v2/v3 policy files all say chunk16; v4 says8. Claimed historical chunk32 for v1/v2 is unverified/conflicts with current files. All action horizons32. No causal sweet-spot claim can be pinned from these snapshots alone.
Tomato v3 latest evaluation field points to later0/1; spam v1 points to later0/2. current_version is3/1 despite retained v4/v2; do not use mutable current/latest pointers as run identity.
Current default simulation dt1/200 with decimation4 gives50Hz environment steps, not100Hz. At this conditional dt, replan32/16/8 corresponds1.5625/3.125/6.25Hz; execution-time dt is not archived.
Slippage, rim collision, geometric/friction explanation and faster true placement require trajectory/video evidence; not established by episode labels or this metadata audit.
